text: why dont u just store it exactly how @GUIDING_LIGHT.md says to, already its going to have to go that way anyways to be able to go from here to in game assets
resolution: Stored paint the GUIDING_LIGHT way (content-address, store once + reference) instead of the localstore base64 hack — and the same form the in-game asset bake reads, so it's the right path forward not a throwaway. The painted texture is PNG-compressed, sha256-hashed (= paintRef), and the model stream interns the blob once (modelStream.paintBlobs) and points the model at it (StoredModel.paintRef via the modelPaintBaked event); studioModel exposes bakePaint/paintRef/paintBlob; meshPaintTexture save/restore/undo/redo now emit (ref, blobB64) bakes instead of writing localstore. Durable across restart, deduped by hash, and proven end-to-end via a probe wipe+restore roundtrip. Adds the imageops (PNG codec) build gate to hmsc-int.
